command: set -eu; git fetch origin; git checkout main; git pull --ff-only origin main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c67752483b07ba88399c6e1e6940c33dd3a2f51f"; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21); export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug; APK=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*debug*.apk' -type f | head -1); test -n "$APK"; adb install -r "$APK"; echo INSTALLED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
